checks.description: Validate required nonempty files, local literal resource/import links, JavaScript syntax, immutable data hashes and shared pure-logic vectors. Does not prove rendering, event wiring, accessibility or taste.

At 360px and 1440px, traverse all baseline views and each job. Build estimates, edit invalid quantities, approve, then change/remove a line and confirm approval invalidation. Switch jobs and return; verify independent session drafts. Inspect actual primitive reuse, new specimens, focus/errors and visual continuity.
checks.detail: manual is a human review cue and does not gate publication
